A leaked draft law (October 2025) would criminalise LGBT conduct and advocacy — up to 3 years for behaviour 'contrary to biological sex and general morality' and 4 years for same-sex ceremonies — and would raise gender-affirming-care eligibility from 18 to 25 with a permanent-infertility mandate, exposing providers to fines and up to 7 years and patients to up to 3 years; 15 LGBT groups and the national medical association objected. No province-specific ordinance, incident series or court decision concerning trans visitors in this province was documented in this research pass; the national framework above is the whole documented picture for this province. The absence of recorded provincial enforcement is not evidence of local tolerance, and equally not evidence of a local ban.

The page has nothing province-specific, so it functions purely as the framework document under which a visitor to this province stands.
